description: The full text of one published item, by the id search or a list returns (such as "viupdate:<slug>", "goodday:036", "straightrecord:042" or "paper:<slug>") or by its public URL. Use for reading an article or edition before quoting or summarizing it. Returns up to 40,000 characters at a time inside a fence labeled as untrusted data; a longer item continues from next_offset. Metadata carries the date, the credit, the citeAs line and, for a VI Update article with a video, the Facebook link. A Paper is also found by its PDF link or its DOI, and comes back as its listing: the summary, the PDF and DOI links, the data behind it, its license and its citeAs line. The full text of a Paper is the PDF, which this server does not read.

id.description: An id from search, latest or list_items, or the item's public URL; for a Paper, also its PDF link or DOI.

offset.description: Character position to start from, for the next window of a long item. Default 0.

name: fetch
title: Read one item in full
